decision: 不升级为第二条强主创新：具体映射可修通，但尚未证明超出通用二值Gram核加动态BN重排的电路贡献。保留浅层候选身份，现阶段评分不提高。

scores.meaning: novelty / frozen numeric fit / hardware payoff / TCAS-II potential, not acceptance probability

why: Execution-graph replacement is meaningful, but AND-popcount/ownership/transpose/staging/triangular traversal are prior. Complete Gram+contraction+source replay must beat fused output statistics; the kernel alone does not establish contribution.

math_contract.equations: S in {0,1}^{N x C}, fixed W, no bias and no intervening rounding/saturation: G=S^T S; k=diag(G); M1_h=k^T w_h; Q_h=sum_i G_ii w_ih^2 + 2 sum_i<j G_ij w_ih w_jh. Current-domain mu=M1/N; variance=(NQ-M1^2)/N^2.
math_contract.requirements: Use full BN domain including T10 and zero rows; retain all offdiagonal/cross-group terms, signed products, true tail length and snapshot identity. Existing sample0 G is near100% dense.
math_contract.numeric: Frozen ep34 FP32/TF32 with quantization disabled is not bit-equivalent to integer moment propagation. INT8 W requires separate deployment evaluation. Any QDQ/clip before BN breaks the simple quadratic identity.

packing_and_schedule_audit.correction: 873000 is only ideal8-lane issue count. Owner uniqueness removes competing updates, not1RW ports. Eight18-bit counts=144 bits, exceeding128-bit macro word.
packing_and_schedule_audit.naive: Pair-index mod8 ownership gives582 counts/bank; pack7 ->84 words/bank ->8x128x128 macros=16KiB. Per-counter RMW cannot issue every cycle.
packing_and_schedule_audit.repair: Stage whole packed words locally; update seven distinct slots over seven valid operations, write once, prefetch next. SRAM port cost2/7 per update can support II1 if latency/flush hold. Word staging must cover popcount latency; no same-slot revisit before previous write.
packing_and_schedule_audit.state: Two128-bit words/bank=256B registers total, before deeper buffers/tags. Charge macros/readout/clear-or-overwrite, overflow, padding, backpressure and domain drain.
packing_and_schedule_audit.tradeoff: Tile-major keeps128 source rows but revisits G. Pair-major keeps few counters but rereads source columns per pair group. Full-G registers cost84k+ bits/mux/clocks. One source pass+128-row buffer+only8 local counters cannot all hold.

specific_reconstruction.scope: One repaired C96 design point; no new primitive.
specific_reconstruction.mapping: Cache column i, broadcast it to8 AND-popcount lanes. Read j banked by j mod8, mask j<i; G(i,j) belongs to same j-owner bank. Packed counter-word staging replaces arbitrary16-column source reads.
specific_reconstruction.rate: 624 batches/128-row block ->936000 for stage0,7.22% above873000 ideal. Owner counts540..624 require78..90 packed words each:8 count macros. Schedule counts, not measured cycles.
specific_reconstruction.anchor: Prefetch i+1 when encountered in prior i traversal. Initial anchor/missed overlap still cost; prove buffer identity/lifetime. Fixed-i broadcast is prior.
specific_reconstruction.source_storage: 128x96 double buffer=3072B raw. Registers pay row writes/clocks,8 banked12-to1 column muxes,128-bit wires/anchors. Column SRAM cannot accept96 independent bit writes per row through8 single ports; needs staging/transpose or proven masks.
specific_reconstruction.macro_utilization: One128x128 macro per source-column bank allocates16KiB/buffer versus12-column useful depth; double32KiB, plus count16KiB. Do not price3072B register/raw payload at SRAM density.
specific_reconstruction.ingress: Charge source capture, binary retention/write/read, transpose formation/drain and T replay order. Zero rows remain in N. Double-buffer overlap is rate-limited.

online_contraction.schedule: C x16 INT8 weight block (stage0 1536B); anchor w_i, read w_j, form pair online, multiply unsigned G, double offdiagonal in wide accumulator. Diagonal gives mean too; no C²H ROM.
online_contraction.resource_lower_bound: 16 shared multiplier lanes: ceil(H/16)*(2P+C) slots. Stage0=225792; stage3=113541120. Add dependencies/load/drain/sqrt. Slots are not clocks; binary conditional-add PEs do not supply free wide multipliers.
online_contraction.alternative_baseline: Compare D=GW then w·D: more intermediate traffic, mostly narrower GxW products. Triangular pair product is not automatically best. Online coefficient generation removes ROM, not multiplication.
online_contraction.width: INT8 w_i*w_j fits signed16; storing doubled pair needs17 bits because2*(-128)^2=32768. G is unsigned. Cross terms may be negative; partial Q accumulator must be signed. With C96,N192000, conservative M1 signed33, Q unsigned45/final and signed46/partials; NQ and M1^2 each need63 unsigned bits. Counts require18. Do not reuse Acc24 for moments.
online_contraction.deep_layers: Gram issue stays~0.9M across stages, contraction grows8x/stage. Select layers using actual sparse-FC/memory/area costs; shallow benefit does not justify stage3.

strong_baseline_and_gate.A: Fused sparse FC1+moments, save raw Y, then fused BN/full-T PSN; no normalized tensor materialization.
strong_baseline_and_gate.B: Fused sparse FC1+moments, discard Y, retain binary source, then recompute FC1 into BN/PSN. Allow existing K8/broadcast.
strong_baseline_and_gate.test: Use min(A,B), same arithmetic/area/ports/bandwidth. Candidate pays transpose/G/contraction/coefficients then one normal FC1/BN/PSN. Source2.304MB vsY294.912MB is payload, not measured area/traffic savings.
strong_baseline_and_gate.necessary_condition: Against B: Gram+contraction+extra layout/counter traffic must cost less than replaced FC1/moments pass. Against A: this plus binary retention/replay must fit actual saved raw-Y service. Preserve overlap; do not divide unlike scalar operations.
strong_baseline_and_gate.minimal_next_evidence: Address/valid/port schedule with bounded staging and all-cost layer model before EDA. Also compare generic BISMO-like Gram+online contraction with same macros; no advantage over generic mapping means no demonstrated circuit increment. No trace reprofile here.
